what: The GPU code of study 5's run without momentum (docs/study5-beta0-registration.md): the identity of its GPU paths at the commit named.
engineering_check: The Pod reruns pod 2's Qwen order control of seed 50000 at η_l under this code before anything else and compares it under extension 2's numerical equivalence (scripts/study5_beta0_campaigns.py, block engineering); a failure stops the Pod. The paths changed since the Llama repeat's record add the beta0 role (optimizer.beta1 0 in that role and in no other arm-F role), its configs and its module (seeds, orders, pilot rate rule, drift gate, campaign cells), and list its driver and analysis outside the GPU code; a run of any other role is unchanged (tests/test_study5_beta0.py). A later GPU change needs a new check and a new record.
